about.title: From low-level systems to shipped products.
paragraphs: I am a Software Engineer focused on AI tooling, Rust systems, backend architecture, and full-stack products. I build practical software with strong foundations in typed APIs, developer tools (MCP and Spec-Driven Development), automation, and performance-oriented systems.

Currently at MLP Rent, I work on software engineering, automation, and AI agent integrations; previously at ABEPE, I built and maintained Ruby on Rails web applications and introduced AI-assisted workflow automations.

description: Implemented Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows with detailed technical specs for agent-assisted execution
Built and integrated internal systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and frontier LLMs (Claude, OpenAI)
Automated operational workflows and internal processes, reducing manual errors and delivery bottlenecks
Contributed to architecture decisions and standards for AI agent usage
Developed and maintained web applications with Ruby on Rails following MVC best practices
Integrated RESTful APIs, designed PostgreSQL / MySQL schemas, and resolved production bugs
Researched and introduced AI-assisted automations and agent prototypes for internal workflows
Participated in strategic projects with an integrated view of operations
Structured flows for client acquisition and tracking
Supported organizational culture initiatives, corporate values, and marketing campaigns
Developed project management, consulting, and operations skills
Supported internal engagement processes and commercial structuring
Developed a Python automation solution using Pandas, openpyxl, and Selenium
Reduced time spent on repetitive tasks by 40% and improved processed data accuracy

items.title: Black Hole ASCII Simulation
items.subtitle: 4D Kerr-Schild Geodesic Raymarching in Rust
items.description: Real-time relativistic black hole simulator rendered directly in the terminal in pure Rust with 24-bit TrueColor and Half-Block mode, integrating null geodesics via RK4, Doppler beaming, and Hawking evaporation.

items.title: ABNT MCP
items.subtitle: Academic Research Copilot via Model Context Protocol
items.description: MCP server for scientific research and ABNT-compliant academic writing, featuring normative auditing, Crossref/SciELO source lookup, citation validation, and PDF compilation via Typst and LaTeX.

items.title: FinAI
items.subtitle: Financial Intelligence Platform (Capstone)
items.description: Full-stack AI financial and wealth management platform: imports OFX/CSV statements with LGPD anonymization, auto-categorizes spending, tracks goals, portfolio, and tax modules, and streams an AI financial assistant via SSE with BYOK (AES-256-GCM) security.

items.title: Solar System ASCII
items.subtitle: 3D Keplerian Orbital Simulator in Rust
items.description: 3D terminal Solar System simulator built in pure Rust featuring Keplerian orbital mechanics, procedural raymarching, Rayon parallelism, and high-definition Half-Block/ASCII rendering.

items.title: FURIA CS2 FanBot
items.subtitle: Coding Challenge · FURIA Selection Process
items.description: Full-stack fan platform built as a coding challenge for FURIA's selection process, integrating a Python Telegram bot, cached Fastify REST API, and responsive Next.js landing page orchestrated with Docker Compose.
